text:
Goal: Increased concurent session count

Make it configurable from the Home-Tab 's experience range from 0 (kill all) to 10 (max allowed) with default to 5  (yes, change from current 3 value). Run this interactivelly

Implemented a configurable machine-wide `claude -p` concurrency cap, replacing the hardcoded 3:

**`src/main/lib/sessionSlots.cjs`** — `totalSlots()` now reads a persisted cap (`~/.claude/session-manager/session-slots-config.json`), range `[0, 10]`, default `5` (was env-only, `[1,3]`, default 3). `SM_SESSION_SLOTS` still overrides when set. Added `setCap(n)` (validates, persists atomically, notifies subscribers so a raised cap wakes waiting scheduler/chat lanes). `snapshot()` now also reports `min`/`max`/`default`/`envOverride`. `0` blocks new acquisitions but never touches already-running holders — it's a pause valve, not a kill switch (killing in-flight `claude -p` processes would be a separate, riskier feature I didn't build without it being asked for explicitly).

**IPC**: new `schedule:set-session-slots` handler in `scheduler.cjs`, validated via a new `setSessionSlotsSchema` in `ipcSchemas.cjs`. Exposed through preload (`window.api.schedule.setSessionSlots(cap)`) and typed in `api.d.ts`.

**Home tab** (`Home.tsx`): the "Active sessions" card header now has a live 0–10 range slider next to the "N of M slots in use" text, wired directly to the new IPC call. Also fixed the stale `?? 3` fallbacks in Hero/ActiveSessionsCard to `?? 5`.

**`SessionManagerConfig.tsx`**: updated the "Session pool" section copy to describe the new 0–10 range and point at the Home-tab slider (kept its existing read-only dot display, just fixed the default and clamp text).

Updated `sessionSlots.test.cjs` for the new default/range and added coverage for `setCap`, the 0-pause behavior, and persistence. Verified: `npm run typecheck` clean, `lint:selectors` clean, full `npm run test:unit` — 1790/1790 passing.
